notes: Assertions are copied as expressions, not interpreted as newly observed values. Runtime outcomes are recorded separately.
Fixture literals are suite-level static dependencies plus shared helpers. The fixture manifest follows existing JSON file references conservatively; it is an inventory, not a copy list.
Transport literals and absolute path prefixes are omitted in assertion excerpts; original tests remain authoritative at their source hash.
Source-only package/archive tests are retained in this inventory to identify assertions that must be re-homed or remain archive controls.
